art.title: Lamentation
art.why: A lament, not a glorification: five mourners hold the wounded dead Christ, the crown of thorns at his feet. (Tomás de Merlo's Lamentation was rejected: the NGA gives no description.)

art.title: Dietrich Bonhoeffer
art.why: REUSE of the existing Practice portrait, as the spec suggests; no NGA prison scene exists.

art.title: Winter Harmony
art.why: No camp or barracks in the NGA (spec expected this): a snowbound stream in a wood, the winter landscape the spec allows.

art.title: The Campo di SS. Giovanni e Paolo, Venice
art.why: No NGA crowd in a square of 1989; ordinary people walking and standing in a public square under an equestrian statue and beside a church: everyday public life, where the greengrocer's choice is made.

Beethoven's 'from the heart, may it go to the heart': freedom of conscience in music (check note).
The gospel song King asked for on the night before he was killed (Mahalia Jackson sang it at his funeral).

memory.title: But if not
memory.ref: Daniel 3:17-18 (WEB): "If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up."
